hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member A_i is obtained by applying the associated divided-difference/derivative operator to F; repeated node p uses F'(p)=ds(p).
required_assumptions: p != q where a denominator (p-q) appears
ds(z) is the derivative of s(z) with respect to z
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0001 is the first divided difference of s at p and q, G0002 is the derivative of s at p (the repeated-node divided difference), and G0003 is the second divided difference with repeated p, so all three non-identical catalog members arise from one latent unary function s by node configuration/derivative extension.
